rule: Dedicated Boss AI decision entrypoint exists in the Web playable runtime
remediation: Keep dedicated Boss turn execution entrypoint.

rule: Boss AI should evaluate all candidate cards in state.aiPool rather than blindly popping the last card before scoring
observed: 1 match (line 1762 blindly pops state.aiPool.pop() before evaluating board sockets)
remediation: Evaluate all candidate (cardId, slot) pairs in state.aiPool using selectBossUtilityAction() in boss_ai_utility.js.

rule: Boss AI should score multi-factor normalized 0..1 response curves (flips, edge exposure, topology, boosted column denial, 1-ply counter-flip resistance) with IAUS compensation
observed: 0 matches in live HTML (only scores flips.length integer; random tie-break on line 1766 is overwritten on first iteration when flips.length === 0)
remediation: Integrate boss_ai_utility.js (5 normalized response curves + IAUS compensation + 1-ply lookahead).

rule: Utility AI prototype implements normalized response curves and IAUS makeup compensation (Curves.compensate) in boss_ai_utility.js
remediation: None required; IAUS makeup compensation verified in boss_ai_utility.js:54-59.

rule: Utility AI Grandmaster tier achieves >= 2.0x relative win-rate uplift over the current greedy Boss AI against a Greedy Player across 2,000 simulated matches
remediation: Grandmaster Utility AI achieves 15.95% overall win rate vs 6.65% baseline (2.40x uplift across 2,000 matches).

rule: Utility AI Grandmaster tier achieves >= 25% win rate on Stage 4 (Apex Neural Core) against a Greedy Player
remediation: Grandmaster Utility AI achieves 30.4% win rate on Stage 4 (up from 13.6% baseline) against a Greedy Player.

rule: Utility AI Grandmaster tier achieves >= 60% overall win rate against a Random Player across 2,000 matches
remediation: Grandmaster Utility AI achieves 65.0% overall win rate (85.6% on Stage 4) vs Random Player.

rule: Difficulty tiers (Apprentice, Tactician, Grandmaster) scale monotonically in Boss win rate
remediation: All 3 difficulty tiers (Apprentice 3.5%, Tactician 10.9%, Grandmaster 15.95%) scale monotonically.

rule: Web playable must persist campaign progress (stageIdx, Wins, Losses) to localStorage across page reloads
remediation: Persist stageIdx, Wins, Losses, and unlocked cards to localStorage with a versioned JSON schema.

rule: Unity EchoGhostSnapshot save payload must include an explicit integer schema version field (`public int version = 1;`) from day one
observed: 0 matches in EchoGhostSnapshot (lines 462-470 lack a schema version integer field)
remediation: Add `public int version = 1;` to EchoGhostSnapshot and a sequential migration function `Migrate(raw)`.

rule: Unity EchoGhostPvPManager implements HMAC-SHA256 receipt signing (`HMACSHA256`) for snapshot integrity verification
remediation: Keep HMAC-SHA256 receipt generation for EchoGhostSnapshot integrity checks.

rule: Authoritative PvP HMAC secret key must not be hardcoded in client source (`DefaultReceiptSecret`)
remediation: Move authoritative PvP receipt verification secret to server environment variables; treat client checksum as non-authoritative corruption detection.

rule: Save writes must use atomic temp-file replacement (`.tmp` -> `.bak` -> target) to prevent half-written corrupt saves
observed: 0 matches (EchoGhostSnapshot is serialized via JsonUtility.ToJson without atomic .tmp -> .bak -> target file replacement)
remediation: Write snapshot JSON to `.tmp`, flush to disk, rotate existing save to `.bak`, and atomically rename to target path.

rule: Card stats and stage configurations are externalized into top-level declarative data tables (`ALL_CARDS` and `STAGES`)
remediation: None required; ALL_CARDS (16) and STAGES (4) are cleanly externalized in declarative tables.

rule: Production shippable HTML should not embed automated test harnesses (`runVisualAutomatedPlaytest` / `runDragDropTest`) inline
observed: 1 match at line 2489 (250+ lines of ?autotest=1 and ?dragtest=1 harness code embedded in shippable HTML)
remediation: Extract automated test harnesses into external Playwright test scripts before shipping.

rule: itch.io HTML5 zip root must contain an entry file named `index.html`

probe.command: test -f WebPlayable/index.html && echo true || echo false

remediation: Output build entry file as `index.html` at the root of the itch.io HTML5 zip archive.

rule: itch.io HTML5 builds must not use parent-directory asset traversal (`../GeneratedArt/`) that escapes the zip root
observed: 23 matches (lines 40, 931, 968-1140, 1307-1310 use `../GeneratedArt/...`, which 404s when WebPlayable/ is zipped for itch.io)
remediation: Copy GeneratedArt/ inside the web distribution root and rewrite paths to `./GeneratedArt/...`.

rule: SteamPipe `app_build_*.vdf` and `depot_build_*.vdf` manifests with debug symbol exclusions (`*.pdb`, `*DoNotShip*`) must exist before Steam release

probe.command: find . -maxdepth 3 -name 'app_build*.vdf' | grep -q . && echo true || echo false

remediation: Create SteamPipe `app_build_<appid>.vdf` and `depot_build_<depotid>.vdf` manifests with FileExclusion rules for `*.pdb`, `*.burst.debug*`, and `*DoNotShip*`.
